description_chirho: Pure Rust port of the SWORD Bible software library with full binary format compatibility
goals_chirho: 100% compatibility with SWORD module binary formats
Drop-in CLI replacements for all SWORD utilities
Pure Rust with no C/C++ dependencies

phases_chirho.description_chirho: Features required for basic SWORD module compatibility

tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Add support for encrypted SWORD modules with unlock keys. Required for copyrighted modules like NIV, ESV, NASB.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Create SwCipherChirho struct for AES/Blowfish decryption
Add unlock key storage in module config
tasks_chirho.completion_notes_chirho: Implemented SapphireCipherChirho (stream cipher), XorCipherChirho, CipherFilterChirho, CipherBytesFilterChirho, CipherChirho trait, 15 tests passing total

tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Add legacy LZSS compression support for older SWORD modules.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Add unit tests with known test vectors
tasks_chirho.completion_notes_chirho: Implemented LzssCompressorChirho with compress/decompress, 6 tests passing

tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Complete OSIS XML import parser for creating modules from OSIS source files.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Handle verse elements with proper key generation
Support milestone vs container verse markers
Generate RawText or zText module output
Support all OSIS element types (div, chapter, verse, note, reference, etc.)
tasks_chirho.completion_notes_chirho: Implemented OsisParserChirho with full OSIS XML parsing, milestone/container verse support, markup preservation, Strong's stripping, 6 tests passing

tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Complete TEI XML import parser for dictionaries and lexicons.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Generate RawLD or zLD module output
tasks_chirho.completion_notes_chirho: Implemented TeiParserChirho with full TEI XML parsing for dictionaries, entry/sense/definition structure, cross-references, examples, 10 tests passing

tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Verse-per-line format parser for simple text imports.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Parse lines in format: BookAbbrev Chapter:Verse Text
tasks_chirho.completion_notes_chirho: Implemented VplParserChirho with full parsing, continuation lines, comments, 10 tests passing

tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Add full locale support for book names and abbreviations in multiple languages.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Create LocaleChirho struct with book name mappings
Support locale lookup by language code
Add locale-aware book name output to VerseKeyChirho
Bundle default locales (en, de, es, fr, ru, zh, etc.)
tasks_chirho.completion_notes_chirho: Implemented LocaleChirho, LocaleBookChirho, LocaleManagerChirho with English/Spanish/German locales, 16 tests passing

tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Add toggleable rendering options for module output.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Create GlobalOptionChirho enum (Headings, Footnotes, CrossReferences, RedLetterWords, Morphology, Lemmas, HebrewVowelPoints, GreekAccents, Glosses, Variants)
Add option state management to SwMgrChirho
Create filters: HeadingsFilterChirho, FootnotesFilterChirho, CrossRefFilterChirho, RedLetterFilterChirho, MorphFilterChirho, LemmaFilterChirho
Add -o flag handling to diatheke_chirho for all options
tasks_chirho.completion_notes_chirho: Implemented GlobalOptionsChirho bitflags, GlobalOptionManagerChirho, StrongsStripFilterChirho, StrongsFormatFilterChirho, FootnotesStripFilterChirho, FootnotesFormatFilterChirho, RedLetterStripFilterChirho, RedLetterFormatFilterChirho, 23+ tests passing

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Enhanced Tantivy Search with Boolean Operators
tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement full-featured search with Boolean operators and advanced query syntax.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Parse Boolean operators: AND, OR, NOT
Implement query parser for SWORD-compatible syntax
tasks_chirho.completion_notes_chirho: Implemented QueryParserChirho (Boolean AND/OR/NOT, phrase proximity, wildcards, fuzzy search, field-specific queries), TantivyQueryBuilderChirho, SearchBuilderChirho, SearchScopeChirho, 21 tests passing

tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement full write support for creating and modifying modules.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Add write_verse_chirho() to RawTextChirho and RawText4Chirho
Add write_entry_chirho() to RawLdChirho and RawLd4Chirho
Add append mode for incremental writing
tasks_chirho.completion_notes_chirho: Added write_verse_chirho() and link_verse_chirho() to RawTextChirho and RawText4Chirho, write_entry_chirho() to RawLdChirho, RawLd4Chirho, and RawGenBookChirho, create_chirho() to RawGenBookChirho, create_module_chirho() factory function and CreateModuleOptionsChirho

tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Complete InstallMgr with remote repository support.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Fetch and parse mods.d.tar.gz from remote sources
Compare local vs remote module versions
Support CrossWire, eBible, and custom repositories
Add --upgrade flag for updating all modules
tasks_chirho.completion_notes_chirho: Enhanced InstallMgrChirho with: get_remote_module_info_chirho(), get_installed_module_info_chirho(), check_updates_chirho() for version comparison, upgrade_all_chirho() for batch upgrades, search_modules_chirho() across all sources, refresh_all_sources_chirho(). Added ModuleInfoChirho, ModuleUpdateChirho, SearchResultChirho types.

tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Add caching for frequently accessed verses to improve performance.

tasks_chirho.completion_notes_chirho: Implemented LruCacheChirho with O(1) operations, CachedModuleChirho wrapper, VerseCacheKeyChirho, AtomicCacheStatsChirho for thread-safe stats, 14 tests passing
